language.label: Language
language.description: Follow the system language, or always use another one.

contextLength.label: Context length
contextLength.description: Context length determines how much of your conversation local LLMs can remember and use to generate responses.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Follow the system appearance, or always use light or dark.

closeButton.label: Close button
closeButton.description: Closing the window keeps ChatonLM running in the system tray, so the shortcuts and the Easy Link bots stay available. Turn off to quit ChatonLM instead.
closeButton.switch: Keep running in the system tray
closeButton.noTray: There is no system tray on this desktop: closing the window quits ChatonLM.

menuEntry.label: Applications menu
menuEntry.description: Show ChatonLM in the applications menu of your desktop, to launch this AppImage. Turn off to remove it.

reset.error: ChatonLM could not reset every setting. Check the settings above and try again.

engine.label: Engine
engine.cpuFallback: The graphics card failed during this session: models run on the processor until ChatonLM restarts.
engine.unavailable: The engine is missing from this installation. Reinstall ChatonLM.
engine.statusError: Could not read the engine's state: {message}

cuda.title: NVIDIA acceleration (CUDA)
cuda.offer: Runs models faster on {name} with CUDA. Optional download of about {size}: ChatonLM's CUDA engine, and NVIDIA's libraries from NVIDIA's servers.
cuda.stale: The NVIDIA pack on this computer is for another version of the engine. Download it again to use CUDA.
cuda.license: NVIDIA's libraries (CUDA runtime and cuBLAS) are not open source: they come under the NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit license, and ChatonLM keeps them for its own use only.
cuda.fallback: CUDA failed during this session ({reason}): models use Vulkan until ChatonLM restarts or CUDA is turned back on.
cuda.driverTooOld: The NVIDIA driver {driver} is too old for CUDA 13: version {min} or later is needed. Until then, models use Vulkan.
cuda.computeTooLow: {name} is too old for CUDA 13 (compute capability {compute}, {min} needed): models use Vulkan, which works well on it.
cuda.actionError: The NVIDIA pack couldn't be changed: {message}
cuda.statusError: Could not read the state of the NVIDIA pack: {message}

status.schedule: ChatonLM checks for updates when it starts, then every hour.
status.checkFailed: The last check for updates failed: {detail}
status.ready: ChatonLM version {version} is ready to install
status.restartHint: ChatonLM will close, then start again with the new version.
status.passwordHint: Your system will ask for your password to install it.
status.installerHint: The ChatonLM installer will appear for a moment.
status.installingHint: ChatonLM is stopping its services, then will start again with the new version.
status.installingPassword: Your system is asking for your password to install it.
status.unsupported: Updates can't be installed from ChatonLM

reasons.noPackage: This copy of ChatonLM wasn't installed from a package (AppImage or .deb), so it can't update itself.
reasons.packageManager: ChatonLM was installed by your package manager: updates come through it.
reasons.readOnlyFolder: ChatonLM can't replace the AppImage in its folder. Move it to a folder of your own (for example ~/Applications), then start ChatonLM again from there.
reasons.notInstalled: This copy of ChatonLM wasn't installed with its installer, so it can't update itself. Download the latest installer to update.
reasons.installFolderReadOnly: ChatonLM can't write to its installation folder. Install it again with its installer, in a folder of your own.

error.signature: The downloaded update couldn't be verified

autoDownload.label: Auto-download updates
autoDownload.off: Updates will not be downloaded automatically.

bugReport.title: Report a bug
bugReport.description: Something isn't working? Describe it here. Your message is sent to the ChatonLM team by email, through chatonlm.com. Nothing is sent until you click Send.

message.label: What happened?
message.placeholder: What you did, what you expected, and what happened instead.

email.label: Your email (optional)
email.hint: Only used to reply to you.

diagnostic.label: Attach diagnostic information
diagnostic.hint: Versions, system, the state of the text engine and the end of ChatonLM's log. Never the content of your conversations; your home folder and user name are hidden.

bugReport.sent: Thank you! Your report has been sent.

error.tooMany: Too many reports were sent recently. Try again in an hour.
error.invalidEmail: This email address doesn't look valid.
error.unavailable: The report couldn't be sent. Check your connection and try again, or write to {email}.
error.unknown: The report couldn't be sent ({error}). Try again, or write to {email}.

donate.title: Support ChatonLM
donate.description: Donations keep ChatonLM growing. In particular, they pay for its own servers, such as the one behind web search.

confirm.title: Move your models to the new folder?
confirm.store: ChatonLM will keep your models in {path}.
confirm.useAsIs: Use the new folder as it is only if it already has these models.
confirm.unload: Loaded models will be unloaded first.

modelsFolder.cleanupFailed: Some copies could not be deleted from the old folder {dir}. You can delete them yourself.
modelsFolder.error: Could not change the models folder: {message}

keepAlive.label: Keep models loaded
keepAlive.description: How long a model stays in memory after its last use. Default: 5 minutes.

preload.label: Preload the chosen model
preload.description: Load the model selected in the chat as soon as you choose it and when ChatonLM starts, so your first message doesn't wait.

uncensored.label: Show uncensored models
uncensored.description: Adds an “Uncensored” section to ModelHub: community versions of official models that no longer refuse to answer. They can write offensive or dangerous content, and ChatonLM doesn't check them.

systemPrompt.title: Instructions
systemPrompt.label: System prompt
systemPrompt.description: Sent to the model at the start of every chat, voice messages and Easy Link bots included, and never shown in the chat. It takes the place of the model's built-in system prompt. Leave empty to send none.
systemPrompt.placeholder: For example: Answer in French, briefly and plainly.

vram.label: VRAM
vram.noGpu: No graphics card detected: models run on the processor, in system memory.
vram.unknown: VRAM usage can't be read on this computer.
vram.spilled: {size} doesn't fit in VRAM: that part runs from system memory, more slowly.

remoteModels.title: Remote models
remoteModels.description: Off by default. Adds the models of the providers below to the model picker, with your own API key. They don't run on this computer: the messages you send them go to the provider and count against your account there. ChatonLM pays for no model.
remoteModels.empty: No provider yet. Add one with your API key: Ollama Cloud, OpenRouter, Mistral, or any server compatible with the OpenAI API.
remoteModels.formerServer: ChatonLM used the Ollama at {address}. To use its models again, add it as “Other server (OpenAI-compatible)”.
remoteModels.removeText: Its API key is deleted from this computer, and its models leave the model picker.
remoteModels.removeKeyText: It is deleted from this computer. The provider stays in the list; its models need a key again to answer.

check.noKey: No API key saved for this provider.
check.key: The provider refused this API key.
check.limit: The provider says your usage limit or credit is reached.
check.unreachable: The provider can't be reached. Check your internet connection and the address.
check.notFound: Nothing answers at this address. Check it: it usually ends in /v1.
check.server: The provider answered with an error (HTTP {status}).
check.malformed: The provider's reply can't be read. Is this server compatible with the OpenAI API?

form.name: Name (optional)
form.keyHelp: Created in your account at the provider. Saved on this computer only, readable by you alone.
form.keyOptional: Optional: only if the server asks for one. Saved on this computer only, readable by you alone.
form.keepKey: Leave empty to keep the saved key.
form.keyDropped: The new address doesn't keep the saved key: it is removed when you save. Type it again to keep it.

modelImport.title: Models from Ollama
modelImport.description: Bring over your Ollama models without downloading them again.

builtin.title: Built-in Ollama
builtin.description: The Ollama that came with ChatonLM 0.9.

machine.title: Ollama on this computer
machine.description: Its models are copied: nothing changes for it.

modelImport.shared: This folder also belongs to the Ollama installed on this computer: its models are copied, and nothing in it is ever deleted.
modelImport.copy: These models will be copied: {need} needed, {free} free.
modelImport.copyUnknownFree: These models will be copied: {need} needed.
modelImport.noSpace: Not enough free space: {need} needed, {free} free.

status.redownload: Download it again from Hugging Face.
status.failed: Import failed twice in a row.

problems.ollamaFormat: Stored in a format of Ollama's own: download it again from Hugging Face.
problems.notGguf: Not a GGUF model file: ChatonLM can't use it.
problems.blobMissing: Some of its files are missing.
problems.cloud: Cloud model: there is nothing to import.
problems.invalidName: Its name can't be saved on this computer.
problems.embedding: Embedding model: not used for chats.
problems.unsupported: llama.cpp can't run this kind of model.

modelImport.noTemplate: No chat template: llama.cpp will use a default one.
modelImport.noSuggestion: No equivalent was found on Hugging Face.

report.titleBuiltin: Last import from the built-in Ollama
report.titleMachine: Last import from Ollama on this computer
report.redownload: To download again from Hugging Face:

notice.one: The old folder of the built-in Ollama still takes {size} ({count} file).
notice.other: The old folder of the built-in Ollama still takes {size} ({count} files).

cleanup.hint: Its models have been imported: delete it to free up space.
cleanup.willDisappear: These models were not imported and will be deleted with it:
cleanup.confirmTitle: Delete the old folder of the built-in Ollama?
cleanup.confirmText: {size} will be freed in {dir}. This can't be undone.

failed.one: {count} file could not be deleted: close the programs that use it, then try again.
failed.other: {count} files could not be deleted: close the programs that use them, then try again.

cleanup.error: Could not delete the old folder: {message}

auto.label: Read responses aloud automatically
auto.description: Each new response is read aloud while it's being written, if the voice of its language is downloaded. Older responses aren't read when you open a chat.

voices.title: Voices
voices.description: One voice per language, downloaded once. Responses in other languages aren't read.

voiceMode.loadFailed: Couldn't read the voice mode settings: {message}

turns.label: Taking turns
turns.description: Hands-free: what you say is sent when you pause. Push to talk: hold Space, or the button of the voice bar, while you speak.

pause.label: Pause before sending
pause.description: How long you can stay silent before what you said is sent (hands-free). Choose Long if you're cut off mid-sentence.

bargeIn.label: Interrupt by speaking
bargeIn.description: Speaking over a reply stops it (hands-free). ChatonLM removes its own voice from what the microphone hears (echo cancellation), so this also works with speakers; headphones work best.

keepThink.label: Let models think
keepThink.description: Voice messages keep the choice of the Think button. Off: thinking is turned off when the model allows it, so replies start sooner.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.label: Voice instructions
instructions.description: Sent to the model with each voice message, never saved in the chat. Leave empty to use the default instructions shown in the field.

transcription.label: Speech recognition
transcription.description: Voice mode uses the speech model and the language of dictation.

voices.label: Voices
voices.description: Replies are read aloud with the voice of their language: English, French or Spanish.

easyLink.loadFailed: Couldn't read the Easy Link settings: {message}

intro.description: Talk to your local models from Telegram or Discord, on your phone for example: connect a bot to ChatonLM, link your account, then write to the bot as you would in a chat.

keepOpen.label: ChatonLM must stay open
keepOpen.description: The bot only replies while ChatonLM is running on this computer. By default, closing the window keeps ChatonLM running in the system tray (Settings › General).

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.description: Your models still run on this computer, but the messages you exchange with the bot pass through the servers of Telegram or Discord.

setup.intro: No bot is connected. To create one:

telegram.step3: Paste the token it gives you below.

discord.step1: Open the Discord Developer Portal and create an application.
discord.step4: Once the bot is connected, invite it to one of your servers with the link ChatonLM gives you: Discord only lets you write privately to a bot you share a server with.

bot.removeText: ChatonLM forgets its token and unlinks its accounts. The chats stay in the history.

problem.unauthorized: {platform} refused this token. Remove the bot, then connect it again with a new token.
problem.conflict: Another app is already using this bot, or a webhook is set on it. Close that app, or create a bot just for ChatonLM.
problem.network: Can't reach {platform}. ChatonLM tries again on its own.

invite.description: Discord only lets you write privately to a bot you share a server with. Invite the bot to one of your servers, then send it a direct message. If the bot doesn't answer, allow direct messages from the members of that server in its privacy settings.
invite.button: Invite the bot to a server

pairing.telegram: Open the bot in Telegram with the button below, or send it this code.
pairing.discord: Send this code to the bot in a direct message.

commands.title: Bot commands
commands.intro: Send these commands to the bot, like any other message.
commands.web: Turn web search on or off
commands.ephemeral: Ephemeral mode: chats kept out of the history, erased by /new, /ephemeral off or when ChatonLM quits
commands.keep: Keep the current ephemeral chat in the history
commands.discord: On Discord, commands can also start with “!”, for example !models.
commands.media: You can also send a photo, if the model can see images, or a voice message: it is transcribed by the speech model of dictation you have installed.

vscode.title: VS Code
vscode.label: Let VS Code notify me through Easy Link
vscode.description: When a long task finishes in VS Code (a terminal command, a build, a long answer), the ChatonLM extension can send a short message to your linked accounts: the task's name, how long it took and whether it succeeded. Never your code or the terminal's output. The status command also lists the tasks in progress.

webSearch.title: Web search
webSearch.privacy: Searches go from this computer straight to the search engine below. ChatonLM sees none of them; the search engine sees what you search for and your IP address.
webSearch.howTo: Turn web search on with the globe button in the message box.

engines.duckDuckGo: Default. No account or key needed.
engines.brave: With your own Brave Search API key.
engines.mojeek: With your own Mojeek API key.
engines.searxng: With your own SearXNG instance, its JSON format turned on.

webSearch.fallback: If {engine} doesn't answer, DuckDuckGo takes over.
webSearch.waitingKey: Until a key is saved, DuckDuckGo is used.
webSearch.waitingAddress: Until an address is saved, DuckDuckGo is used.
webSearch.replaceKey: Paste a new key to replace it
webSearch.replaceAddress: Enter a new address to replace it
webSearch.searxngHelp: How to turn on SearXNG's JSON format

vscode.loadFailed: Couldn't read the VS Code settings: {message}

enable.label: Allow VS Code to connect
enable.description: The ChatonLM extension for VS Code talks with your models through a link that stays on this computer: nothing goes through the network.

status.unavailable: VS Code can't connect: this system gives ChatonLM no private folder for the link.
status.failed: The link with VS Code couldn't be opened (another copy of ChatonLM may already be using it). Turn it off and on again to retry.

pairing.needsBridge: Allow VS Code to connect first to pair an editor.
pairing.instructions: In VS Code, run ChatonLM: Pair and type this code.

offerPull.title: Download {model}?
offerPull.message: VS Code asks for {model} to suggest code as you type. The model runs on this computer; nothing you type leaves it.
offerPull.nonCommercial: Its license allows non-commercial use only.

global.title: Global shortcuts
global.description: They work in any app. You set their keys in your desktop, not in ChatonLM.
global.descriptionApp: They work in any app. Choose their keys here.

dictation.label: Dictation
dictation.off: Turn on dictation to use this shortcut.

proofread.label: Correct selected text
proofread.description: Corrects the text selected in any app.
proofread.off: Turn on the shortcut to choose its keys.

paste.label: Replace the selection
paste.description: ChatonLM pastes the corrected text over the selection. Turned off, the corrected text is only copied: press Ctrl+V to paste it.
paste.askHint: The first time, your desktop asks to let ChatonLM send the paste keystroke.

readAloud.label: Read selected text aloud
readAloud.description: Reads aloud the text selected in any app. Use the shortcut again to stop.
readAloud.off: Turn on the shortcut to choose its keys.

global.bindCommand: Bind this command to a shortcut in your system settings:

actions.voiceModeSpace: I'm done, or interrupt the reply (push to talk: hold to speak)
actions.pasteInReview: Paste at the end of the corrected text

recorder.label: New shortcut: {name}
recorder.hint: Use Ctrl, Alt or the Windows key with a letter, a digit or a function key.
